card.name: Adverse reactions in skin-reaction warnings
card.fires_on: The word reactions (or events) right after 'severe cutaneous adverse' or 'serious skin adverse' in skin-reaction warnings. It also fires on the closing piece of a number or abbreviation, such as the last 0 in 77,000 or the ) in (OIED).

modes.label: Skin adverse reactions
